in_sanskrit.name: अजित
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is unconquered, invincible, unvanquished, and undying.

in_marathi.name: Ajita
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ajita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Ajita is derived from Sanskrit, and it is composed of two words: Aji (unconquered) and ta (that). This name is given to a girl who is believed to be invincible, unconquerable, and fearless. In Hindu mythology, there is a story about a queen named Ajita who, despite being in deep meditation, was disturbed by her husband's doubts about her devotion. She responded with such profound wisdom and compassion that her husband was enlightened, and they both attained moksha (liberation).
